what_it_does: C.A.T.S. helps engineers optimize entire programs by tracking where memory is accessed and how control flow moves through the code, showing this information through interactive timelines and diagrams. Unlike traditional approaches that focus on obvious performance bottlenecks, C.A.T.S. identifies inefficiencies in data layout, unused variables that consume memory, and algorithm choices that could be improved. It captures these insights as static compiler analysis and visualization tools so engineers can systematically explore optimization opportunities.
